regions.label: Rumen
regions.description: Largest compartment; fermentation vat where microbes make VFAs, CO2 and methane; papillae enlarge the absorptive surface.

regions.label: Reticulum
regions.description: Honeycomb lining; heavy foreign objects settle here (hardware disease); contractions mix ingesta and start regurgitation.

regions.label: Omasum
regions.description: Leaf-like laminae; absorbs water and some minerals and VFAs.

regions.label: Abomasum
regions.description: Glandular (true) stomach; secretes HCl and pepsinogen.

regions.label: Esophagus
regions.description: Carries feed down and regurgitated cud back up; enters at the reticulorumen.

regions.label: To duodenum
regions.description: Beginning of the small intestine, receiving ingesta from the abomasum.
